cohort: 670 women with GDM (229 conceived through ART and 441 conceived spontaneously)
finding: The study found no significant differences in the outcomes of GDM pregnancies conceived through ART compared to those conceived spontaneously, except for higher plasma glucose, total cholesterol, and triglyceride levels at diagnosis, and a higher frequency of thyroid dysfunction and cesarean sections in the ART group.
mod_finding: The frequency of cesarean section was higher in the ART group (50.3%) compared to the spontaneous conception group (41.2%).
birth_weight: No significant differences in birth weight were found between groups, except for the birth weight of the second twin, which was significantly lower in the ART group
